question.text: A body of mass <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>m</mi></math> is projected with a speed <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>u</mi></math> making an angle of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>45</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></msup></math> with the ground. The angular momentum of the body about the point of projection, at the highest point is expressed as <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mrow><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mi>m</mi><msup><mi>u</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></mrow><mrow><mi>X</mi><mi>g</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>X</mi></math> is_______.

solution.text:
Consider projection as shown in above diagram.

At the topmost point, velocity of the body will be ucos45°.

Therefore, we can write the required angular momentum as 

L=muH×H=mucosθu2sin2θ2g

=mu3×142g⇒X=8
